attempts: Immutable typed attempts; unresolved never means normal; corrections supersede
case_selection: Exact case ID plus confirmed intent; synthetic fixtures not live classifiers
dependencies: Exact approved hashes; mandatory source, warning, units and context retained
eligibility: All required predicates TRUE; FALSE blocks; UNKNOWN clarifies only via reviewed source-derived question; absent question withholds action
figure_display: No end-user PDF/excerpts/crops authorized by this package
followup: With no approved next edge, refer to authorised service; retain separate unresolved issues
repeat: No automatic repeat or adaptive next step authorized
resolved: Rider-reported symptom resolution only; preserve mandatory service inspection and other open issues
safety: Approved known safety stop retains warning and precedes operational failures
visual_review: Finite original manual image-grounded text may be approved; no general rider-photo model validation implied
